texts.NIV84: Listen, my sons, to a father's instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.
texts.KJV: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
texts.NKJV:
Hear, my children, the instruction of a father,
And give attention to know understanding;
texts.DRB: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend that you may know prudence.

texts.NIV84: I give you sound learning, so do not forsake my teaching.
texts.KJV: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
texts.NKJV:
For I give you good doctrine:
Do not forsake my law.
texts.DRB: I will give you a good gift, forsake not my law.

texts.NIV84: When I was a boy in my father's house, still tender, and an only child of my mother,
texts.KJV: For I was my father's son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
texts.NKJV:
When I was my father’s son,
Tender and the only one in the sight of my mother,
texts.DRB: For I also was my father's son, tender and as an only son in the sight of my mother:

texts.NIV84: he taught me and said, "Lay hold of my words with all your heart; keep my commands and you will live.
texts.KJV: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
texts.DRB: And he taught me, and said: Let thy heart receive my words, keep my commandments, and thou shalt live.

blocks.title: Get Wisdom for She is Your Life

texts.NIV84: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or swerve from them.
texts.KJV: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
texts.NKJV:
Get wisdom! Get understanding!
Do not forget, nor turn away from the words of my mouth.
texts.DRB: Get wisdom, get prudence: forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth.

texts.NIV84: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will protect you; love her, and she will watch over you.
texts.KJV: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
texts.NKJV:
Do not forsake her, and she will preserve you;
Love her, and she will keep you.
texts.DRB: Forsake her not, and she shall keep thee: love her, and she shall preserve thee.

texts.NIV84: Wisdom is supreme; therefore get wisdom. Though it cost all you have, get understanding.
texts.KJV: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
texts.DRB: The beginning of wisdom, get wisdom, and with all thy possession purchase prudence.

texts.NIV84: Esteem her, and she will exalt you; embrace her, and she will honor you.
texts.KJV: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
texts.NKJV:
Exalt her, and she will promote you;
She will bring you honor, when you embrace her.
texts.DRB: Take hold on her, and she shall exalt thee: thou shalt be glorified by her, when thou shalt embrace her.

texts.NIV84: She will set a garland of grace on your head and present you with a crown of splendor."
texts.KJV: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
texts.NKJV:
She will place on your head an ornament of grace;
A crown of glory she will deliver to you.”
texts.DRB: She shall give to thy head increase of graces, and protect thee with a noble crown.

texts.NIV84: Listen, my son, accept what I say, and the years of your life will be many.
texts.KJV: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
texts.NKJV:
Hear, my son, and receive my sayings,
And the years of your life will be many.
texts.DRB: Hear, O my son, and receive my words, that years of life may be multiplied to thee.

texts.NIV84: I guide you in the way of wisdom and lead you along straight paths.
texts.KJV: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
texts.NKJV:
I have taught you in the way of wisdom;
I have led you in right paths.
texts.DRB: I will shew thee the way of wisdom, I will lead thee by the paths of equity:

texts.NIV84: When you walk, your steps will not be hampered; when you run, you will not stumble.
texts.KJV: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
texts.NKJV:
When you walk, your steps will not be hindered,
And when you run, you will not stumble.
texts.DRB: Which when thou shalt have entered, thy steps shall not be straitened, and when thou runnest thou shalt not meet a stumblingblock.

texts.NIV84: Hold on to instruction, do not let it go; guard it well, for it is your life.
texts.KJV: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
texts.NKJV:
Take firm hold of instruction, do not let go;
Keep her, for she is your life.
texts.DRB: Take hold on instruction, leave it not: keep it, because it is thy life.

texts.NIV84: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evil men.
texts.KJV: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
texts.NKJV:
Do not enter the path of the wicked,
And do not walk in the way of evil.
texts.DRB: Be not delighted in the paths of the wicked, neither let the way of evil men please thee.

texts.NIV84: Avoid it, do not travel on it; turn from it and go on your way.
texts.KJV: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
texts.NKJV:
Avoid it, do not travel on it;
Turn away from it and pass on.
texts.DRB: Flee from it, pass not by it: go aside, and forsake it.

texts.NIV84: For they cannot sleep till they do evil; they are robbed of slumber till they make someone fall.
texts.KJV: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
texts.NKJV:
For they do not sleep unless they have done evil;
And their sleep is taken away unless they make someone fall.
texts.DRB: For they sleep not except they have done evil: and their sleep is taken away unless they have made some to fall.

texts.NIV84: They eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
texts.KJV: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
texts.NKJV:
For they eat the bread of wickedness,
And drink the wine of violence.
texts.DRB: They eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of iniquity.

texts.NIV84: The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.
texts.KJV: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
texts.NKJV:
But the path of the just is like the shining sun,
That shines ever brighter unto the perfect day.
texts.DRB: But the path of the just, as a shining light, goeth forwards and increaseth even to perfect day.

texts.NIV84: But the way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.
texts.KJV: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
texts.NKJV:
The way of the wicked is like darkness;
They do not know what makes them stumble.
texts.DRB: The way of the wicked is darksome: they know not where they fall.

blocks.title: Watch & Guard Eyes, Ears and Heart

texts.NIV84: My son, pay attention to what I say; listen closely to my words.
texts.KJV: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
texts.NKJV:
My son, give attention to my words;
Incline your ear to my sayings.
texts.DRB: My son, hearken to my words, and incline thy ear to my sayings.

texts.NIV84: Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart;
texts.KJV: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
texts.NKJV:
Do not let them depart from your eyes;
Keep them in the midst of your heart;
texts.DRB: Let them not depart from thy eyes, keep them in the midst of thy heart:

texts.NIV84: for they are life to those who find them and health to a man's whole body.
texts.KJV: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
texts.NKJV:
For they are life to those who find them,
And health to all their flesh.
texts.DRB: For they are life to those that find them, and health to all flesh.

texts.NIV84: Above all else, guard your heart, for it is the wellspring of life.
texts.KJV: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
texts.NKJV:
Keep your heart with all diligence,
For out of it spring the issues of life.
texts.DRB: With all watchfulness keep thy heart, because life issueth out from it.

texts.NIV84: Put away perversity from your mouth; keep corrupt talk far from your lips.
texts.KJV: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
texts.NKJV:
Put away from you a deceitful mouth,
And put perverse lips far from you.
texts.DRB: Remove from thee a froward mouth, and let detracting lips be far from thee.

texts.NIV84: Let your eyes look straight ahead, fix your gaze directly before you.
texts.KJV: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
texts.NKJV:
Let your eyes look straight ahead,
And your eyelids look right before you.
texts.DRB: Let thy eyes look straight on, and let thy eyelids go before thy steps.

texts.NIV84: Make level paths for your feet and take only ways that are firm.
texts.KJV: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
texts.NKJV:
Ponder the path of your feet,
And let all your ways be established.
texts.DRB: Make straight the path for thy feet, and all thy ways shall be established.

texts.NIV84: Do not swerve to the right or the left; keep your foot from evil.
texts.KJV: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
texts.NKJV:
Do not turn to the right or the left;
Remove your foot from evil.
texts.DRB: Decline not to the right hand, nor to the left: turn away thy foot from evil. For the Lord knoweth the ways that are on the right hand: but those are perverse which are on the left hand. But he will make thy courses straight, he will bring forward thy ways in peace.
